chunks: Abi (may Allah have mercy on him) from Sa’d ibn Abdillah from Ya’qub ibn Yazid from Ibn Fadhal, who raised it to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
One who enjoys tasting water in the world, Allah will make him enjoy the drinks of Paradise.

key_terms.أَشْرِبَةِ: drinks / beverages (specifically referring to the drinks of Paradise)

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for enjoying water in this world according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In Thawab al-Amal, Shaykh al-Saduq highlights the principle of *muqabala* (correspondence), where the sensory pleasure derived from water in the dunya serves as a precursor to the superior, pure beverages of Jannah. This narration encourages believers to view mundane acts of appreciation as spiritual preparation, reinforcing the Shia emphasis on finding divine signs in everyday physical blessings.
